description: NaLiB₂(NH₅)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaLiB₂(NH₅)₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six H atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.39 Å. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.53 Å. Li is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six H atoms. The Li-N bond length is 2.07 Å. There are a spread of Li-H bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one N and three H atoms. The B-N bond length is 1.56 Å. There are a spread of B-H bond distances ranging from 1.23-1.25 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one N and three H atoms. The B-N bond length is 1.55 Å. There are two shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) B-H bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.02 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Li, one B, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.02 Å. There are ten inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the seventh H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the eighth H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the ninth H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the tenth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Li and one B atom.
